_comment: Evidence Desk (2026-10-21): which official-statistics series a business-lane run pulls for an industry. Read by openclaw-bridge/mcp/business-sources/series-map.js. Industry matching is by word-start prefix against the run's `industry` input first, then its `topic`; the first industry that matches wins, and the default series are always added. Extend deliberately: every id added here must be requested from its API once and return data before it is committed (record that in `reviewed`). An id that stops returning data is dropped by its fetcher at run time and named in the log; it is never replaced by a guess.

reviewed.bls: Every BLS series id below was requested from the BLS Public Data API v1 on 2026-10-21 in one batched POST and returned data; a deliberately invalid control id (CES9999999999) came back 'Series does not exist for Series CES9999999999'. The employment levels returned confirm each industry's scope (e.g. CES6562000001 = 23,958.6 thousand, which is health care AND social assistance, NAICS 62).
reviewed.bls_titles: BLS v1 returns values only, never series titles. Titles and units here are written from the BLS series-id structure: CES = Current Employment Statistics, seasonally adjusted; data type 01 = all employees (thousands), 03 = average hourly earnings of all employees (dollars), 08 = average hourly earnings of production and nonsupervisory employees (dollars). CUUR = CPI for All Urban Consumers, U.S. city average, not seasonally adjusted, index 1982-84=100. LNS14000000 = unemployment rate, 16 years and over, seasonally adjusted. PCU = Producer Price Index by industry (index).
reviewed.eurostat: Every Eurostat dataset and filter below was requested from the Eurostat dissemination API (statistics/1.0) on 2026-10-21 and returned exactly one value for DE and for EU27_2020. Dimension codes were read from the API's own response, not assumed.
reviewed.census: County Business Patterns 2023 and its variables NAICS2017, ESTAB ('Number of establishments'), EMP ('Number of employees') and PAYANN ('Annual payroll ($1,000)') were confirmed from the keyless Census variables metadata on 2026-10-21. A data request needs a key (keyless answers HTTP 200 with an HTML 'Missing Key' page), so no data value has been read yet.
reviewed.eia: NOT live-verified: every EIA request needs a key. These ids follow EIA's documented legacy series-id form and must be requested once when the EIA key is registered (docs/business-research-lane.md, P2 activation).
